units.source_text: 侍女便将此答诗转达源氏公子。

en.t: The maid then conveyed this reply poem to Prince Genji.

units.source_text: 公子说：“如此间接传言通问，我从未经历，颇感不惯。

en.t: The prince said, "I have never before exchanged messages through others in this indirect way, and I find it rather unfamiliar.

units.source_text: 但愿乘此良机，拜见一面，郑重申诉。

en.t: I only hope to take this good opportunity to meet you once and present my plea respectfully.

units.source_text: 不胜惶恐待命之至。”

en.t: With deepest awe, I await your command."

units.source_text: 侍女反报，老尼姑说：“公子想必有所误解了。

en.t: When the maid reported back, the elderly nun said, "The prince must surely have misunderstood.

units.source_text: 我觉得很难为情，对这位高贵人物，教我怎么回答呢？”

en.t: I feel terribly embarrassed; how am I to answer such a noble person?"

units.source_text: 众侍女说：“若不会面，深恐见怪。”

en.t: The maids said, "If you do not meet him, we fear he may take offense."

units.source_text: 老尼姑说：“说得有理。

en.t: The elderly nun said, "You are right.

units.source_text: 我若是年轻人，确有不便之处；老身何必回避？

en.t: If I were a young woman, there would indeed be impropriety, but why should an old woman like me avoid him?

units.source_text: 来意如此郑重，甚不敢当。”

en.t: His purpose is so earnest that I hardly deserve such consideration."

units.source_text: 便走到公子近旁。

en.t: She then walked over near the prince.

units.source_text: 源氏公子开言道：“小生唐突奉访，难免轻率之罪！

en.t: Prince Genji began, "In coming here so abruptly, I cannot escape the fault of rashness.

units.source_text: 但衷心耿耿，并无恶意。

en.t: But my heart is sincere, and I have no ill intent.

units.source_text: 我佛慈悲，定蒙鉴察。”

en.t: In the Buddha's compassion, this surely will be seen and understood."

units.source_text: 他看见这老尼姑道貌岸然，气度高雅，

en.t: Seeing that the elderly nun had a solemn bearing and an elegant manner,

units.source_text: 心中不免畏缩，要说的话，急切不能出口。

en.t: he could not help shrinking inwardly, and the words he meant to say would not quickly come out.

units.source_text: 老尼姑答道：“大驾降临，真乃意外之荣幸。

en.t: The elderly nun replied, "Your honored visit is truly an unexpected privilege.

units.source_text: 复蒙如此不吝赐教，此生福缘非浅！”

en.t: To receive such generous words from you as well is no small blessing in this life."

units.source_text: 源氏公子说：“闻尊处有无母之儿，

en.t: Prince Genji said, "I have heard that there is a motherless child in your care.

units.source_text: 小生愿代其母，悉心抚育，不知能蒙惠许否？

en.t: I wish to take the place of her mother and raise her with all my heart; might I be granted permission?

units.source_text: 小生孩提之年，即失慈亲，孤苦度日，以至于今。

en.t: I myself lost my dear mother in childhood and have lived in loneliness down to this day.

units.source_text: 我俩同病相怜，务请视为天生良伴。

en.t: Since we share the same sorrow, please regard us as natural companions.

units.source_text: 今日得仰尊颜，实乃难得之良机。

en.t: To behold you today is truly a rare opportunity.

units.source_text: 因此不揣冒昧，罄吐愚诚。”

en.t: Therefore, though I know it is presumptuous, I pour out my humble sincerity."

units.source_text: 老尼姑答道：“公子此意，老身不胜感激。

en.t: The elderly nun replied, "I am deeply grateful for your intention, my lord.

units.source_text: 惟恐传闻失实，甚是遗憾。

en.t: Yet I fear what you have heard is not quite true, which I greatly regret.

units.source_text: 此间确有一无母之儿，依靠此衰朽之老身艰辛度日。

en.t: There is indeed a motherless child here, living with difficulty by relying on this frail old woman.

units.source_text: 但此儿年尚幼稚，全不解事。

en.t: But the child is still very young and understands nothing of such matters.

units.source_text: 即使公子气度宽宏，亦决难容忍。

en.t: Even with your generous nature, my lord, you could surely not endure it.

units.source_text: 为此未敢奉命。”

en.t: For that reason, I dare not accept your request."

units.source_text: 源氏公子说：“凡此种种，小生均已详悉，师姑不须挂念。

en.t: Prince Genji said, "I already know all these circumstances in detail, so please do not worry, reverend lady.

units.source_text: 小生恋慕小姐，用心非寻常可比，务求谅鉴。”

en.t: My affection for the young lady is far from ordinary; I beg you to understand it."

units.source_text: 老尼姑以为年龄太不相称，公子不知，故发此言。

en.t: The elderly nun thought he spoke this way because he did not know how mismatched their ages were.

units.source_text: 因此并不开诚答复。

en.t: For that reason, she did not answer him frankly.

units.source_text: 此时僧都即将来到，源氏公子说：“罢了。

en.t: Just then the bishop was about to arrive, and Prince Genji said, "Very well.

units.source_text: 小生已将心事陈明，心里就踏实了。”

en.t: I have now made my feelings clear, and my heart is at ease."

units.source_text: 便将屏风拉上，回进室内。

en.t: He then drew the screen closed and went back into the room.
